dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: 'kay, furnace, check... anvil, check... and you've even got a shop sign and display rack. Yeah, this is a fully equipped blacksmith's you got here. You just need to light it up and get smithing.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: *yawn*... I'm suddenly feeling a little tired. Just looking at this stuff reminds me of being back at work...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: ...Nope, it's not gonna pass, I'm getting sleepier by the second. I'm gonna need to take a nap...
